desc: The Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad is a premier business school located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. It is one of the Indian Institutes of Management and was accorded the status of an Institute of National Importance by the Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India in 2017. It is regarded as the best business school in India and is often referred to as the Harvard Business School of India.

desc: The University of Delhi, also known as Delhi University is a collegiate research central university located in Delhi, India.
